errors: loop/gate.py:143 Offline-tolerant remote tag lookup is not implemented. remote_tag maps timeout and any non-zero ls-remote to UNREACHABLE, and check_spec refuses to pass. suggestions: lock_spec treats any non-None remote_tag result as a signal to force-push. UNREACHABLE takes that branch, and the push has no timeout and does not set GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0.
test_result_then_silence_keeps_verdict should assert exit code 0. review() discards the verdict on any non-zero status, and the test only checks the text.
Add a verify_pr case for a post-pass path under .loop/ that fails LOOP_LAYOUT. The current test covers a valid result.json and a src/ file.
base_sha is taken from .loop/state/<task>.json, and evidence commits may modify that file. Record the reviewed merge-base on the gate/<task> tag and read it from there.
loop/README.md still describes mark as head equality plus any .loop/ evidence commit.
